content.title: A History of the Warfare of Science with Theology in Christendom (1896)
content.author: Andrew Dickson White
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: The two-volume history that, with Draper, fixed the image of a long war between science and theology. Cited as a primary record of that thesis, which historians of science now reject, not as reliable history. Public domain.
